title: Ssireum
tagline: Read their balance, hook the sash, win the fall.
description: Ssireum, the sash wrestling of Korea, as a duel of reading. Both wrestlers secretly choose a pull, hook or root each beat; push the rival's balance dot over the edge of its disc. Five rivals, three rings, pass-the-phone for two, or watch and learn.
howToPlay: Pick Pull, Hook or Root, then a power: Light, Firm or Full.
Tap a petal: on their disc to send them, on yours to root against a pull.
Lock in. Both moves play at once and the dots move.
Power costs grip, and a hard pull throws you off balance too.
Push their dot over the edge to win a fall; first to two falls wins.
